mapper.select: SELECT e.user_id FROM enrollments e INNER JOIN teachers t ON t.user_id = e.user_id WHERE e.course_id = #{courseId}
SELECT e.course_id FROM enrollments e INNER JOIN teachers t ON t.user_id = e.user_id WHERE e.user_id = #{teacherId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM enrollments e USING teachers t WHERE e.user_id = t.user_id AND e.course_id = #{courseId}
